'''Amira Moselle''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] and a former [[Sitter]] of the [[Red Ajah]].{{ref/book|0|14}}

==Appearance==
She was stocky, had a square face, and wore her long hair braided in the [[Taraboner]] fashion. The braids were brightly beaded and long eough to flail. {{ref/book|0|14}}{{ref|{{twotc}}}}

==Strength and Abilities==
Amira is of [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|low average]] strength for an Aes Sedai, with a [[One Power]] level of {{opsl|33}}. She is one of the weakest Sitters that we know of.

==History==
Amira was born in {{ne|823}} and went to the Tower in {{ne|839}}. She remained novice eleven years and nine as Accepted and she was raised to the shawl in {{ne|859}}.{{ref|{{twotc}}}} 

She was the [[Mistress of Novices]] during [[Sierin Vayu]]'s time on the [[Amyrlin Seat]].{{ref/book|0|14}} At that time it was considered quite an odd choice that Sierin, elected Amyrlin from the Gray Ajah, chose as Mistress of Novices and Keeper of the Chronicles two sisters from the Red (Amira and [[Duhara]]).

She was a [[Sitter]] for the Red Ajah in recent years.{{ref|[[Source:Tor Questions of the Week, 1 February 2005 - 19 July 2005]]}} Most probably she was elected Sitter in {{ne|985}}, along [[Pevara]] and [[Teslyn]], to replace the three Red Sitters deposed and exiled for the involvement of the Red Ajah in "[[the Vileness]]".

==Activities==
In late {{Ne|998}}, around the time of [[Logain Ablar]]'s delivery to the Tower, she stepped down from her position as Sitter and was replaced in the Hall by [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan]]. {{ref|{{twotc}}}} {{ref|[[Source:Tor Questions of the Week, 1 February 2005 - 19 July 2005]]}}

Amira was one of the Aes Sedai sent in the secret expedition from the [[White Tower]] to kidnap [[Rand]] in [[Cairhien]]. She was killed at the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]].{{ref|[[Source:Tor Questions of the Week, 1 February 2005 - 19 July 2005]]}} <ref>Documentation regarding her association with the Cairhienin embassy and her death in the Battle of Dumai's Wells provided from Wheel of Time Encyclopedia: http://encyclopaedia-wot.org/characters/a/amira.html</ref>
